newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sharp to boost LCD output capacity - paper.
newsitem.headline: Sharp to boost LCD output capacity - paper.

text.p: Sharp Corp will invest about 10 billion yen to boost its capacity to produce large liquid crystal displays (LCDs) by about 30 percent by the spring, a Japanese business daily said on Tuesday.

The Nihon Keizai Shimbun said that Sharp would increase production capacity for thin-film-transistor (TFT) LCDs at its plant in Mie Prefecture in central Japan to 200,000 units a month from 150,000 a month currently.
The move was prompted by rising demand for large LCDs for notebook-sized personal computers, the paper said.
Sharp spokesmen were not immediately available for comment on the report.
